description_en: Suspends a data migration task that is in progress
description_zh: 暂停处于迁移中的数据迁移任务
kebab_example: aliyun dts suspend-migration-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --migration-job-id dtsj1x11y51g3b0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SuspendMigrationJob

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the data migration instance. You can call the DescribeMigrationJobs operation to query instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据迁移实例ID，可以通过调用DescribeMigrationJobs接口查询
parameters.name: migration_job_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter will be discontinued
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call failed
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回对应的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.
